note: Employers whose public job postings come in as jobs (scripts/ingest/run.mjs postings). One line per employer: the name its board goes by, the company exactly as our data names it (and, in also, other companies we list under their own names whose factories the same board hires for), the hiring system and the board's token or address. An employer that is not read says why under leftOut. states says where NEW jobs are ported from: Texas, unless a line says its own states. It looks forward only: a job already ported from a place elsewhere is kept in step with its posting as before, and no new job is made there; a board is read while its company has a factory in those states or still has an open job from that board. The lines are in the order they are read, which is the order of priority: the employers with factories in Texas first, the largest first (by the people recorded at their Texas factories, then by how many factories), those that make machines, transportation equipment, aerospace and defense, semiconductors and electronics, and electrical and industrial equipment ahead of the other industries; then the employers with no factory in Texas, read for the jobs already ported; food and drink last. The boards of a platform that has a budget for a run (Workday's) are read after the others: a board never read first, then the board that has waited longest since its last turn, and this order settles a tie, so it is the order among the boards never read. scripts/ingest/postings/registry.mjs --check holds this file to its shape. Nothing behind SmartRecruiters' API is listed: its robots file disallows it. A line whose note says it was added unverified on Nov 26, 2026 has never been asked for: the machine that keeps this file does not ask Workday. Each such Workday address is the board the employer's own indexed pages or site name, written under /wday/cxs with the tenant taken to be the first word of the host, as it is on every board read so far; its first run from GitHub is its verification, and a board that does not answer is written to that run and nothing else happens.
